summary: TRACK 28.08 · Phase 0 mobile-device certification (390x844) for D1/D2 route aliases and D4 PortalShell mobile overflow. D1 (both signed-out and signed-in) PASSED. D2 (all three aliases, both signed-out and signed-in) PASSED. D4 overflow-menu behavior and D4 desktop regression PASSED. D4 no-horizontal-scroll FAILED on /admin/operations-control ONLY, and the root cause is NOT the PortalShell header (which is a clean 390px) but a page-content overflow inside the Trust Center summary row (Healthy/Attention/Critical/Unknown + Last-refreshed timestamp + Refresh button in a single flex row). Other PortalShell pages tested render without horizontal scroll on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal scroll on 390x844: document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 515, clientWidth = 390 (125px overflow). PortalShell header itself is 390px (fine, D4 shell rebuild is correct). Culprit is the Trust Center summary row: <div class='flex items-center gap-4 text-sm'> containing Healthy 6 / Attention 2 / Critical 5 / Unknown 0 counters + 'Last refreshed Jul 11, 2026 · 12:48 AM' timestamp + Refresh button. Row measures width=450px, right=515px, left=65px on a 390px viewport. The Refresh button (data-testid=trust-layer-refresh) sits at left=425, right=515. This row needs to wrap (flex-wrap) or collapse the timestamp/refresh onto a second line on <md.

Desktop utility cluster (SEARCH, SWITCH PORTAL, clock, EN/ES LangToggle, Super Admin user badge, Home, Sign Out) all render normally. scrollWidth=1280, clientWidth=1280, no horizontal scroll.

/fleet.note: URL stayed at /fleet but PortalShell header did not mount within 8s wait; page rendered without horizontal scroll.

/safety.note: Same as /fleet -- URL stayed at /safety; no PortalShell header detected; no horizontal scroll.

/admin/executive-overview.note: Executive Overview page rendered (visually confirmed in first sign-in), but data-testid=ds-portal-shell-header not detected inside 8s wait. No horizontal scroll.

action_items: Fix D4 residual on /admin/operations-control: make the Trust Center summary row (containing HEALTHY/ATTENTION/CRITICAL/UNKNOWN counters + 'Last refreshed' timestamp + Refresh button) wrap on <md. Suggest adding flex-wrap and grouping the Refresh button + timestamp into a shrink-friendly cluster with min-w-0, or hiding the 'Last refreshed' label text on <md and stacking the Refresh button below. Current row width=450px on a 390px viewport, pushing scrollWidth to 515.

OPTIONAL/INFO: /fleet, /safety, /admin/executive-overview did not expose data-testid=ds-portal-shell-header within an 8s wait -- if these pages are expected to mount PortalShell, verify the testid is present. They did render without horizontal scroll, so it's not a Phase 0 blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalShell header rebuild for mobile is correct: header carries overflow-hidden, header width equals viewport width (390==390 on all pages tested), and the ••• overflow popover surfaces the exact three controls specified (search, portal-switcher, lang-toggle). Notification bell, Home, and Sign Out remain in the top bar next to •••. Desktop (>=md) correctly hides the ••• trigger and shows the full utility cluster.
The D1 and D2 <Navigate replace> aliases resolve correctly through the admin guard for both signed-out and signed-in flows.
Residual horizontal-scroll bug on Operations Control Center is a page-content defect, not a shell defect. The rebuilt PortalShell is not the source.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sign-in flow: on 390x844, use page.locator('input[type=email]').type(...) + input[type=password]).type(...) + pwd.press('Enter'). Direct button clicks without a settle delay occasionally do not fire the /api/auth/multi-login POST in this Playwright build; pressing Enter is reliable. Super Admin lands at /admin after login. PortalShell mounts on /admin/operations-control and /hr (confirmed via data-testid=ds-portal-shell-header). /fleet, /safety, and /admin/executive-overview render but did not expose that testid within the wait window -- may need a longer wait or the pages use a different wrapper.
rca of the issue: D4 residual failure on /admin/operations-control is caused by the Trust Center summary strip laid out as a single non-wrapping flex row: [Healthy N] [Attention N] [Critical N] [Unknown N] [Last refreshed <timestamp>] [Refresh button]. On a 390px viewport this row measures width=450px, extending from left=65 to right=515 (125px past the viewport). The parent container correctly constrains itself but this inner flex row overflows and stretches document.documentElement.scrollWidth to 515. Mitigation: add `flex-wrap` (or `md:flex-nowrap flex-wrap` + `gap-2`), or on <md collapse the 'Last refreshed' cluster below the counters, or hide the timestamp text and keep only the Refresh icon-button aligned right with `ml-auto`.
